items.title: From Zero to the Desire-Realm Dhyana
items.practice: The teacher's complete from-zero roadmap: the karma doctrine and the ban on 'it is all empty' talk; the no-fighting, no-killing, no-meat cascade with the dream-test for the meat precept; the lust-quota wave model of how craving leaves; and the meridian sequence — both lotus postures opening the two sides, the body then opening the central channel on its own, the ren-du circuit from the kidneys to the crown and back, and the three-qi-returning-to-the-origin event that marks the desire-realm dhyana
